title: How AI Understands Language
description: How can a computer chat, translate, and understand your words? Meet Natural Language Processing.

content.value: Natural Language Processing (NLP) is the part of AI that helps computers understand, read, and write human language, like English, Hindi, or Spanish. It's how machines turn messy human words into something they can work with.
Why Human Language is Hard for Computers

Computers love clear, exact instructions, but human language is full of tricky bits. The same word can mean different things ('bat' the animal vs 'bat' for cricket). We use slang, make typos, and rely on context. NLP is all about helping computers deal with this messiness.
How AI Turns Words into Numbers

Just like images become numbers, so do words. NLP first breaks a sentence into small pieces called tokens (usually words or parts of words), then turns each piece into numbers the computer can compare. Words with similar meanings end up with similar numbers, so 'happy' and 'glad' land close together.

"I love pizza"
      │
      ▼  split into tokens
[ "I", "love", "pizza" ]
      │
      ▼  turn each token into numbers
[ 12, 843, 559 ]   ← now the AI can work with it

✍️  Text Generation     → write stories, answers, and emails
🌐  Translation         → change English into French instantly
🎙️  Speech Recognition  → turn your voice into text
😀  Sentiment Analysis  → tell if a review is happy or angry
📄  Summarizing         → shrink a long article into key points
🔎  Answering questions → find the answer inside a document

You already use NLP all the time! ChatGPT and Claude answer questions, Siri and Alexa understand your voice, and Google Translate switches between languages. Autocorrect and predictive text on your phone are NLP too, every time your keyboard guesses your next word, that's NLP at work.

Activity: 'Explain It Simply': Ask an AI assistant to explain a tricky school topic 'like I'm 10 years old.' Then ask it to translate the same explanation into another language. Notice how it reshapes the language both times.
Key Takeaway: NLP enables machines to understand and generate human language, by turning messy words into numbers they can work with.

quiz.question: What does NLP stand for?
quiz.explain: NLP = Natural Language Processing, helping computers work with human language.

quiz.question: Which of these is an NLP task?
quiz.explain: Translation is a classic NLP task, along with text generation, speech recognition, and sentiment analysis.

quiz.question: Which everyday tool uses NLP?
options: A voice assistant like Siri or Alexa
quiz.explain: Voice assistants use NLP to understand your spoken words and reply in language you understand.

quiz.question: Before an AI can work with a sentence, it first...
options: Breaks it into small pieces (tokens) and turns them into numbers
quiz.explain: NLP splits text into tokens and converts them into numbers, so words with similar meanings get similar numbers.
